PlayerProgress.title: PlayerProgress
PlayerProgress.description: Stores a player's Block Crush high scores, best combo, adventure level progress, and audio/haptic preferences.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the player.

classicBestScore.description: Highest score achieved in Classic 8x8 mode.

highestAdventureLevel.description: Highest unlocked Adventure level from 1 to 96.

completedLevels.description: Bounded list of completed Adventure level numbers (max 96).

totalStars.description: Total stars earned across Adventure levels.

totalLinesCleared.description: Cumulative rows and columns cleared across all games.

soundEnabled.description: Whether game sound effects are enabled.

hapticsEnabled.description: Whether haptic vibration feedback is enabled.

welcomeLetterSeen.description: Whether the welcome envelope letter has been dismissed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of document creation (clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update (clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

MatchRecord.title: MatchRecord
MatchRecord.description: Immutable summary of a completed Classic or Adventure Block Crush session.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the player.

levelNumber.description: Adventure level number (1-96) or 0 for Classic mode.

score.description: Final score achieved in the match.

bestCombo.description: Best combo achieved in the match.

linesCleared.description: Total lines cleared in the match.

won.description: True if an Adventure level goal was completed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the match record was saved (clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Player profile, Classic high scores, Adventure progress, and settings scoped strictly to the owning user.

/users/{userId}/matches/{matchId}.description: Subcollection of completed Classic and Adventure match logs owned by the user.
